Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram:

This Miscellaneous Second appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 17.11.2018 passed in L.A.C.Appeal.No.197/2016 on the file of the Principal District Judge at Hassan, and judgment and decree dated 10.10.2011 passed in L.A.C.No.83/2010 on the file of the Senior Civil Judge at Holenarasipura, seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits that in respect of the similar acquisition, in the connected matters already the order of the Reference Court is set aside and the matters are remanded back to the Reference Court for fresh consideration.
While remanding the matter, the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court had permitted the appellant to make the beneficiary as a party before the Reference Court.

3. Considering the order passed by the Co-ordinate bench of this Court in M.S.A.No.68/2023 arising out of the very same land acquisition proceedings, this Court is passing the following:
NC: 2025:KHC:15579 ORDER i.
The judgment and award dated 17.11.2018 passed in L.A.C.Appeal.No.197/2016 on the file of the Principal District Judge at Hassan, is set- aside

and the matter is remanded back to the Reference Court for fresh disposal in accordance with law.
ii. The beneficiary shall be made as a party before the Reference Court.
iii. Liberty is given to both the parties to adduce evidence if they are so advised, both oral and documentary.
iv.

All the parties shall appear before the Reference Court on 10.06.2025 without further notice and the Reference Court shall decide the case and pass appropriate orders within a period of six months from thereon.
v. All contentions of parties are kept open.
